youtube.title: Zoomy's Animal Sounds Road Trip! (BUMP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🚗 BUMP! Zoomy the car hit a bump on the road, and all the animal friends ran off to hide! Can you help Zoomy find them?

Go on an animal sounds road trip with Zoomy! Zoomy drives to the farm, the pond, the meadow, the sky and the night, and meets a cow, a frog, a sheep, a bird, an owl and a horse. Listen to each animal's REAL sound, then sing Zoomy's animal song! Stay till the end, because someone is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 animal names with Zoomy
✔️ Hear the real sounds animals make
✔️ Learn where animals live: farm, pond, sky and night
✔️ Sing an animal sounds song with Zoomy!

⏱️ Chapters

0:04 BUMP! Oh no!
